verdict.summary: The round-2 diff remains documentation-only and is accurate. `apply_migration` is implemented as three passes (issue upsert, body-marker stamping, then label reconciliation); blocker and parent relationships are written only as body markers; `fetch_native_blockers` is read-only; and `verify_migration` explicitly refuses to use native count summaries as proof that a specific marker landed. The dispatch statement also matches `open_blocker_count`, which holds an issue when either the native count or an open marker blocker is nonzero. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is introduced.
